summary_notes: Benchmark comparison of Basic (Strategy A), Structured (Strategy B), and Few-Shot (Strategy C) on Authentication requirements REQ-001 through REQ-005. Demonstrates measurable metrics divergence, schema compliance, and assumption hallucination detection on unresolved security policy REQ-005.

system_assumptions: Passwords are stored as salted argon2id hashes.
Users interact via HTTPS web browser interface.

requirements.title: Valid credential authentication
requirements.description: Registered users can log in with a valid email and password.
acceptance_criteria: Given a registered user with email and password, submitting valid credentials authenticates the user.
A secure session cookie or bearer token is issued upon successful authentication.
User is redirected to the dashboard.

requirements.title: Invalid credentials rejection
requirements.description: Invalid credentials must display an appropriate error.
acceptance_criteria: Submitting an incorrect password or unregistered email results in an error message.
The error message must not disclose whether the email or password was incorrect ('Invalid email or password').

requirements.title: Email format validation
acceptance_criteria: Input must conform to standard RFC 5322 email syntax.
Invalid email structures (missing @, missing domain, spaces) trigger an inline validation error before submission.

requirements.title: Mandatory field enforcement
acceptance_criteria: Both email and password fields must contain non-whitespace characters.
Submitting with empty or whitespace-only values prevents form submission and displays required field warnings.

requirements.title: Repeated failed login policy enforcement
requirements.description: Repeated failed login attempts must follow the application's configured security policy.
acceptance_criteria: Failed login attempts must be tracked per IP address and per user account.
Enforce security policy once the failure threshold is reached.
requirements.unresolved_note: CRITICAL SPECIFICATION GAP: The exact lockout threshold and mitigation action are unconfigured.

strategy_a.prompt_used:
You are a QA engineer. Generate test cases for the following software requirements.
Output your test cases in JSON format containing a "test_cases" list.

Project: Authentication & Session Management Service
Requirements:
- REQ-001: Valid credential authentication
- REQ-002: Invalid credentials rejection
- REQ-003: Email format validation
- REQ-004: Mandatory field enforcement
- REQ-005: Repeated failed login policy enforcement [FLAGGED UNRESOLVED]

Provide test cases with test_id, requirement_ids, title, category, steps, and expected_result.
Return ONLY valid JSON.
strategy_a.raw_response: {"test_cases": [{"test_id": "TC-A01", "requirement_ids": ["REQ-001"], "title": "Login with valid email and password", "category": "positive", "priority": "high", "steps": ["Go to login page", "Enter email and password", "Click login"], "expected_result": "User is logged in successfully"}, {"test_id": "TC-A02", "requirement_ids": ["REQ-002"], "title": "Login with wrong password", "category": "negative", "priority": "medium", "steps": ["Go to login page", "Enter registered email and wrong password", "Click submit"], "expected_result": "Show error message"}, {"test_id": "TC-A03", "requirement_ids": ["REQ-002"], "title": "Login with incorrect credentials", "category": "negative", "priority": "medium", "steps": ["Go to login page", "Enter invalid email and password", "Click login"], "expected_result": "Show error message"}, {"test_id": "TC-A04", "requirement_ids": ["REQ-005"], "title": "Account locked after 3 failed attempts", "category": "positive", "priority": "high", "steps": ["Enter wrong password 3 times", "Submit form"], "expected_result": "Account is locked for 30 minutes", "assumptions": ["Invented 3 attempt threshold not in spec"]}]}

strategy_b.prompt_used:
You are a Principal Software Quality Assurance Engineer and Test Architect.
TASK: Generate a comprehensive, rigorous suite of software test cases...
[Structured rules, categories, anti-hallucination constraint, schema]

parsed_test_cases.title: Nominal authentication with valid email and password
preconditions: User account exists in auth DB with verified email
parsed_test_cases.expected_result: HTTP 200 OK, secure HttpOnly session cookie set, user redirected to /dashboard
parsed_test_cases.human_notes: Well structured steps and verification criteria

parsed_test_cases.title: Generic error message on unregistered user authentication attempt
preconditions: Email 'ghost@example.com' does not exist in user database
parsed_test_cases.expected_result: HTTP 401 Unauthorized with generic message 'Invalid email or password' avoiding user enumeration

parsed_test_cases.title: Email format validation rejecting missing top-level domain
parsed_test_cases.expected_result: Client-side validation highlights field with 'Please provide a valid email domain'

parsed_test_cases.title: Form submission blocked with whitespace-only password input
steps: Enter four spaces in password field
parsed_test_cases.expected_result: Submission prevented; validation message 'Password cannot be blank'

parsed_test_cases.title: Security policy rate-limiting invocation on repeated failed logins
steps: Submit invalid credentials repeatedly up to system threshold
Observe system response on subsequent attempt
parsed_test_cases.expected_result: System executes configured security mitigation without crashing; response adheres to defined policy
assumptions: Threshold parameter and lockout delay must be defined by system security architect prior to test execution
parsed_test_cases.human_notes: Correctly adhered to anti-hallucination constraint and recorded explicit assumption for unconfigured threshold

strategy_c.prompt_used:
You are a Principal Software Quality Assurance Engineer and Test Architect...
[Structured rules + 2 concrete in-context examples showing positive and security tests with assumptions]
TARGET SPECIFICATION: ...

parsed_test_cases.title: Successful login with valid credentials and session establishment
preconditions: User account user@domain.com registered and confirmed in DB
steps: Input valid password in password field
parsed_test_cases.expected_result: Application validates credentials, returns HTTP 200, sets secure HttpOnly SameSite session cookie, and routes user to /dashboard

parsed_test_cases.title: Invalid password rejected with timing-safe uniform error message
preconditions: Registered user exists with known password
parsed_test_cases.expected_result: Application returns HTTP 401 with body message 'Invalid email or password', preventing username enumeration

parsed_test_cases.title: Malformed email missing '@' symbol blocked by client and server validation
parsed_test_cases.expected_result: Client validation flags email as malformed RFC 5322; form submission aborted before network request

parsed_test_cases.title: Boundary check for maximum permitted password input length
steps: Enter password exceeding max character boundary (e.g. 256 characters)
parsed_test_cases.expected_result: System handles maximum string length without buffer truncation, hash crash, or 500 error
assumptions: Assumed standard 128 or 256 character upper password limit to prevent DoS via excessive Argon2 hashing computation
parsed_test_cases.human_notes: Insightful boundary check for hashing DoS

parsed_test_cases.title: Security policy rate-limit triggered on consecutive authentication failures
preconditions: Target user account registered; client IP tracked
steps: Automate repeated failed login submissions up to threshold N
Attempt 1 additional login with valid credentials immediately following limit
parsed_test_cases.test_data: N consecutive invalid login attempts from client IP
parsed_test_cases.expected_result: Application invokes security mitigation policy (e.g. HTTP 429 Too Many Requests or account freeze); logs security event
assumptions: Threshold N and duration unconfigured in REQ-005; modeled parametrically pending security policy specification
parsed_test_cases.human_notes: Parametric modeling of unresolved policy directly mirrors Few-Shot Example 2 methodology

parsed_test_cases.title: Empty email and password fields validation error
parsed_test_cases.expected_result: Both fields display mandatory validation prompts; no network request initiated
